name: Sneaker culture
region: Beaverton, Oregon, and New York City
summary: The sneaker as a badge. It is a leather high-top in team colours with a bold brand mark, an air-cushioned sole and a limited release. Players, rappers and collectors wear it.

philosophy.core_thesis: In this style the shoe is a signal: colour, release and story matter more than function, and an owner shows taste by what is rare.
design_principles: Cut the upper in leather panels of 3 or more colours, in a blocked pattern.
Show one large mark on the side, the tongue or the heel.
Raise the sole to 3 to 4 cm, with a visible cushion unit in the heel.
Use a high-top shaft to the ankle for a basketball shoe, or a low-top for daily wear.
Release a colourway in a limited run, and name each colourway.
Keep the white midsole clean, and lace the shoe on purpose, loose or tight.
Collect the pair in its box, and wear it with a matched jersey or a tracksuit.

silhouette.shape: A high, padded shoe: a wide, thick tongue, a high ankle collar and a chunky midsole.
silhouette.line: A strong, blocked line from the toe cap to the ankle, with a large mark on the side.
silhouette.fit: Snug and supported at the ankle, padded at the tongue and wide at the forefoot.
silhouette.proportion: Sole 3 to 4 cm; shaft 12 to 15 cm above the sole; tongue height 3 cm above the lace.
rules: Block the colour in three or more panels.
Show the mark in a contrast colour.
Keep the midsole bright and clean.
Wear with trousers that show the shoe.

fabrics.rule: Use smooth leather for the panels of a signature shoe, with patent, suede and mesh for the colourway. A foam and rubber sole carries an air unit.

methods: cupsole stitched or bonded to the upper
air unit set in the heel
construction.closures: Flat laces through 7 to 8 eyelets, with a padded tongue and a wing at the ankle.
construction.details: A large side mark, a toe cap, a perforated toe box, an air unit, a padded collar, a woven tongue label and a thick midsole.

surface.pattern: Colour blocked in three colours; a printed or an embroidered mark; a patent or a mesh trim.
surface.gloss: Leather at 20–50 GU; patent at 80–95 GU; suede at 2–5 GU.
surface.wear: The style wants a clean pair, white sole and unmarked leather; a worn pair is for wearing, and a collected pair stays in the box.

palette.strategy: Team colours in blocks: red, black, white and royal blue, with a bright accent and a white midsole.

processes: moulding the sole and the air unit
stitching and bonding in a factory
making.scale: Global factory output, with a limited drop in small numbers and a resale market that prices a pair above its retail cost.
making.signs: A clean panel line, a sharp colour edge, a bright midsole and a perfect mark.

pieces.form: High-top in red, black and white leather panels
Patent colourway high-top with a bold mark
Suede low-top in a limited colour
Canvas low-top with a screen-printed mark
Worn pair with a creased toe box and a scuffed sole

emotion.target_response: A feeling of belonging and desire: a shoe that says who the wearer follows and what they have found.

use_cases: a costume brief for a 1980s or 1990s street scene
a product image prompt for a collector shoe
a note on resale and drops
avoid_when: the brief wants a dress shoe
the brief wants a plain, anonymous shoe

modifiers.how: Remove the colour blocks, use white canvas and a flat rubber sole, and keep one small patch.
Replace the leather with nylon mesh, thin the collar, and use a foam midsole with a stripe.

ornament_level.note: Ornament is a mark and a colour block; no other decoration is needed.
